title: IoT + Electronics Domain — Analysis Output Schema
description: Structured preliminary feasibility analysis output. Version 1.1. Uncertainty is structurally allowed — null is never a failure. The platform decides PASS/WARN/BLOCK from this output. The AI does not.

input_assessment.description: Assessment of input quality before any analysis. Determines how much the AI can reliably say.

sufficient_for_analysis.description: Can a meaningful preliminary analysis be produced from the provided input? If false, missing_information should dominate the output.

confidence_level.description: LOW = input is sparse or vague. MEDIUM = input covers main aspects. HIGH = input is detailed and specific. HIGH is rarely justified for a preliminary analysis.

limiting_factors_ar.description: What specific gaps in the input limit the reliability of this analysis.

description_ar.description: Neutral restatement of the idea as understood from the input. No added assumptions.

apparent_domain_tags.description: Domain tags that appear to apply based on what was stated. Empty array is valid if input is too vague.

clarification_needed_ar.description: If the idea description is ambiguous, state what needs clarification before a reliable summary can be made.

feasibility.description: Preliminary feasibility signals only. Not a determination. Not a gate decision.

assessment_possible.description: Can a feasibility signal be given from the available input? If false, feasibility_signal must be INSUFFICIENT_INPUT.

feasibility_signal.description: Preliminary signal only. The platform gate engine converts this to PASS/WARN/BLOCK using defined rules. Do not select a signal that implies a gate decision.

signal_basis_ar.description: What specifically in the input led to this signal. Must reference stated information only — no invented assumptions.

complexity_indication.description: Rough complexity indication if enough information exists. Null if cannot be determined.

prototype_path_clarity.description: Whether the input describes enough of a technical path to discuss prototyping. DESCRIBED_PATH_EXISTS means the user described steps — not that prototyping will succeed. Null if prototyping was not addressed in the input.

observations.description: Optional section. Structured observations about technical aspects — based only on stated input. Clearly separated from assumptions.

apparent_components_ar.description: Components that appear to be needed based on what the user described. Not a BOM. Not a recommendation.

component_ar.description: Component type — not a specific model unless user mentioned one

basis_ar.description: What in the user's description suggests this component is needed

component_specificity.description: Whether this component was explicitly named by the user, clearly implied by the description, or is uncertain. Distinguishes observation from assumption.

power_observations_ar.description: Observations about power requirements based only on what was stated. Null if user provided no power-related information. No assumed values.

connectivity_observations_ar.description: Observations about connectivity based only on what was stated. Null if user provided no connectivity information.

identified_concerns.description: Technical concerns visible from the stated description. Not invented. Not assumed.

basis_ar.description: What in the stated description raises this concern — no invented information

missing_information.description: The most important section when input is incomplete. Honest gaps are more valuable than fabricated analysis.

has_critical_gaps.description: True if any CRITICAL gap exists that prevents meaningful feasibility assessment.

why_it_matters_ar.description: Why this gap limits the analysis — not a generic statement

how_to_provide_ar.description: Specific actionable guidance for the user to fill this gap

next_steps_suggestion.description: Optional. Only include if input was sufficient to warrant specific suggestions. Omit entirely if not enough is known.

suggestion_possible.description: Is there enough information to suggest meaningful next steps? If false, omit items.

items_ar.description: Concrete next steps grounded in stated information. Not generic advice.

disclaimer_ar.description: Mandatory. Must clearly state: this is a preliminary analysis only, based on provided information, not an engineering certification, and PASS/WARN/BLOCK is determined by the platform — not by this analysis.
